claims.claim: Brain Sync retains bounded single-NEXT proof, exact control facts and fail-closed conflicts. The current unauthored BO-2/3 NEXT exposes TASK_AUTHORING without fabricated TASK or Unified State. Canonical blob reads now preserve surrounding whitespace and terminal newlines.

Context relevance uses closed versioned Flow Card, lifecycle, subject and request inputs. Elision uses explicit deterministic rules with bounded source-digest provenance and rejects semantic-looking rules.
Disposable reuse requires complete current source/projection bindings. Existing regressions cover binding movement, poisoning and deletion equivalence without granting cache authority.

Compiled bounded context applies budgeting after projection, elision and reuse. Only supporting detail may overflow; exact controls remain preserved, and compressed dependencies require bounded canonical expansion and rebinding. Composition and resolution retain observation-only authority.

Regressions cover split-brain planning, unauthored NEXT, stale bindings, cache deletion, overflow, exact expansion, exact controls and malformed relevance. Four reported failures and detached missing/ambiguous authority cases passed affected local checks. The live smoke establishes an isolated explicit upstream binding.

The committed repair modifies only the two permitted files, preserving CANONICAL_CONTEXT_PIPELINE_V1, its three compatibility exits and the prior collection fix. It adds no later-phase implementation or lifecycle mutation authority.
